batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b KK Ahmed

batting.name: R Ashwin
batting.dismissal: c T Stubbs b AR Patel

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c Sandeep Sharma b Avesh Khan

batting.name: RK Bhui
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b N Burger

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b YS Chahal

batting.name: Abishek Porel
batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b YS Chahal

balls.text: A bit anticlimactic but the final over goes for two million anyway. Yorker on leg, 144ks, helped along to deep fine leg.
Parag's in boundayville! Dude, how do you pull a 144ks bouncer like that?! It's angling in too. Does it with ridiculous ease and clears deep midwicket by a mile

Wide yorker goes against Nortje again! Parag tries to slam it over cover again, gets another thick edge. This is not as in-between the two fielders but short third has no chance of taking it to the left

Slotsville and Parag's doing it and is aware too! Points to his partner and is all smiles. This was 143ks outside off, he was really stable on impact, had a diagonal stance, and lumped it over long-off
Parag had a stable base, was on the back foot and pulled it high and mighty over midwicket
Unlucky for Nortje, Parag gets four between keeper and short third. Yorker around fourth, he tried to slap it through cover and got an edge

Similar ball, Hetmyer goes deeper in the crease, has all the weight on the back foot while slashing. Not the perfect connection but gets the ball to drop in the backward-point outfield. Checking for a short run. He's just about managed to slide the bat in the crease

Caught-behind appeal. Pant's confident. Review taken. 136ks. Replay's taking a bit of time and Hetmyer practises a few reverse sweeps. Ball was very full, just inside the tramline Hetmyer tried to adjust and slash it square. No edge, review lost.
Starts walking and gets a low wide fully. Wouldn't have been far from a yorker had he stayed still, but he was able to get to a position from which he could slice it through cover

Mukesh misses the yorker this time, Hetmyer slog sweeps it and has an end-to-end grin. 136ks knee-roll height full toss, he lunged and bashed it. He points to the dugout and is chuffed. Fielder has to wait a bit for the fans to return the ball
Another yorker nailed. From wide of the crease, on middle, jammed to deep midwicket

Lands the yorker perfectly. Hetmyer has that diagonal stance going, front foot towards mid-on and back foot towards first slip, but can't get underneath it. Almost nutmegs it, gets it off the bottom of the bat to the leg side
Wide and full, angle takes it too far.. Let go

Bumper beats the lunge-hook, 138ks, not given wide. Hetmyer reviews. Was fast, angling in and Hetmyer crouched and the ball was in line with his front leg when it went past him. So the on-field call stands
Nortje bowls wide on a back of length, Parag slashes off the upper-half of the bat. Goes to deep cover on the bounce
Low fully on seventh from wide of the crease, tries crashing it late but gets no bat on it. There's a sweeper cover and wide third out. So he's bowling to the field
Yorker angling in to middle, clipped to to midwicket

Paddled onto off stump, that's a rare visual. Jurel picked the fast, full ball from outside the offside tramline, seemed to have middled it but unintentionally sent the bails on a sexy-looking flight. Second of those on the night after Jaiswal's dismissal. Nortje is pumped
Premeditated shuffle across, Nortje sees him and tries following him with a short cutter.
Pummelled over midwicket. 90ks, googly, not that short. Parag was in the crease, on the back foot, had the stablest of bases and whacked it with an upper-body swivel
Long hop but very fast. 115ks. Jurel went across, got too far inside the line but managed to pull it to deep square leg
Pulls the length ball from outside off that was racing past Warner's right but he charged across and stopped it with his extended right hand
Bottom edge goes below keeper, who tries following it. The length ball was very wide to start with, Jurel reached out and tried slapping it nonetheless.
Wide, shortish and slow. Slapped to long-off
Fullish on the pads, 83ks, beats the flick and goes off the pad to short fine leg

Mid-off was in and Parag thumps it through the line to bring up fifty. Slot ball, might be a missed yorker, it was coming on off stump and it was an easy step-hit for Parag. Raises his bat and looks up as the crowd applaud. He's in a good position to finish on a high too.
Back to the wide yorker and beating bat. Centimetres inside the tramline, Parag tried stepping forward and hitting it square but the ball still sped under bat

Change of line, too straight and Parag helps it along. Four to backward square. 135ks, attempted yorker but Parag's standing inside the crease and is able to pick it up. No deep fielder there, so a bad ball
Yorker outside off, 134ks, Parag tries to drill it but can only jam it to cover.
Yorker on sixth, 135ks, jammed while standing in front of off stump. Gets it to short third
Heaved off a hard length from outside off. Seam-up and Jurel did go across, heaved it across despite the ball shaping away. Got it into the midwicket boundary
Whisked away to the offside

Slashed over extra cover. Picked the bones off the 126ks slower ball, too full though. Easy step hit for the batter, might've picked it off the hand, got it off the bottom-third of the bat. Ponting not too happy, probably with the fielder not getting close enough
Low fully on fifth, attempted yorker at 140ks, Parag is up to it. Takes a small stride forward, lunges low and opens the blade to direct it through the backward-point gap
Helped over the fine-leg boundary. RR have played from-the-crease shots really well when the bowlers have gone short even slightly short, which was the case this time.
Tucked-up proper. Into the pitch, angling in, Jurel was caught hurried, shaped to play the pull but was halfway into the shot when ball hit bat and went to the leg side

Bat-pad or not? Pant and Khaleel have a long-ish chat, the bowler asked to go with one second to go but Pant isn't convinced. Good call in the end as there was an inside edge on the attempted off-drive before it hit pad. Replay comes in an over later, it was ball hitting pad first but impact would've been umpire's call
Fullish on leg, 101ks, worked off the back foot to deep midwicket. RR take the timeout
Arm ball on a length, off stump, punched to long-on. 101ks
Length on leg, clipped around the corner

Ashwin tries to clear deep midwicket but can't. 95ks length ball angling in, he saw it in his half and tried went for a stand-up slog sweep. Got a decent chunk but not enough to clear Stubbs, who took it and swivelled back, the step was within the cushion. Ashwin's given RR's innings some impetus though
Length on middle and off, Parag tries to flick through midwicket but the 99ks ball takes the leading edge and goes to point
Back of length, middle and leg, 103ks, pulled to deep midwicket

Gorgeous ball to beat bat. Went the other way. Length ball landed on off, 83ks, and went away. Parag went for the straight drive but got tentative last second. Well well, Pant's reviewd for a caught behind. It's really close but nothing detected on Ultra-Edge. Review ost.
Kuldeep varying line and length now. Goes wide on a length, 82ks, Parag reaches out and slaps it to long-off
Length around fifth, 87ks, punched towards cover
Darted down leg, 89ks, fullish and Parag tried shovel-sweeping it fine. Misses. Pant half-stops it

Wow that's a heck of a pull! The swivel from deep in the crease made it look even more powerful. 94 metres far it goes. Wasn't all that short, was going around fourth, Parag limboed back and lumped it over midwicket
Flat-bat swipe is miscued, falls safely and goes to long-on
Length at the stumps, 84ks, clipped to deep-forward square leg
Arm ball on a length, leg-stump line, worked to long-on.
Guided to the off side
Uppish drive, no check, lands safely and rolls to long-off. Length outside off, Parag tried hitting on top of the bounce, may have come in slower than he expected
Length outside off, chopped off the underedge to point
Tries to pull the shortish flat dart on top of the pads. Goes square, misses completely. 110ks
Chopped towards backward point
Parag can't connect with the pull. Not dissimilar to the fourth ball in terms of length. But line was tighter, around fourth stump and the pace sharper at 146ks.
Full at the stumps, goes legside of the ball and tries to drive hard through the line. Plinks it to long-on
Shorter, pulled harder! 142ks and was shorter than the first ball but it rose just under rib-height. Ashwin, in the crease, was unfazed
Fullish on leg, clipped to the leg side
He can't double down though, had a funky attempt did Ashwin. Went across and tried to paddle it over fine leg. The length ball hit him and deflected towards third
Ash Anna big-dogging Nortje now! Into the pitch, top-of-off, doesn't matter! Ashwin stands still and lumps it over the leg side. Pulled to perfection from deep in the crease
Full on leg, clipped to long-on

Dances down and mows it over wide long-on! He carried the momentum and swung freely, got it 84 metres far. It was on a length around off, he stayed a bit leg side and had a rotational swipe. Ashwin big-dogs Kuldeep on this occasion to bring up the first six of the innings. This could turn into an interesting battle though
Length on leg, clipped to square leg. 97ks
Full around off, 88ks, pushed to long-off

Similar length, just down leg, 98ks. Ashwin tries to go across and clip it. Ump thinks it's missed everything. Thought Pant reviewed the wide but Virender Sharma sad it's a stumping appeal if I heard that right. No edge, Ashwin's feet were well in the crease, he was getting off-balance but managed to keep the tip-toe in the crease. The caught behind was checked
Length on middle, good dip, 83ks. Bowled from close to the crease, driven to deep cover off the back foot
Full on the pads, clipped to long-on
Tries to clip the shortish ball with the closed face. Misses. Timeout
Too short and Parag ends the 31-ball boundary drought. It was 103ks, angled in at the pads, helped away with the pull from waist-height and got it to the long-leg fence
Maybe like Matthew Hayden said on air, Ashwin might have been in to tackle spin. They are trying to milk them too. This is clipped off the pads to midwicket
Fullish around fourth, punched to deep point
Clips it off the pads to midwicket
Darted on a back of length on leg, punched off the back foot to long-on
Length at the stumps, 95ks, worked to deep midwicket
Full around off, pushed to the left of cover. 103ks
Length on off, backs away and punches it to deep point
Length around off, tries clipping it to midwicket. Uppish leading edge takes it to cover

Beaten on the reverse, lbw appeal turned down. Kuldeep took the matter, and literally Rishabh's hands, into his own and signalled the T. Where did this pitch though? Buttler tried playing it on the up, got beaten and ball hit just under the knee-roll, outer-half of the pad. It has pitched in line and Kuldeep might as well have Hawk-Eye tech embedded in him cos the ball is projected to land in line and go on to smash leg peg. It landed around a back of length too, which makes his conviction look even better. Buttler tried to break out of his struggle but perishes in the attempt
Full around off, just 83ks, Parag leans across and gets real low to punch it to long-off
Fullish around off, Buttler tries punching towards mid-off. Gets it off the inside-half of the bat and to the bowler. 99ks
Length dart on leg, tries to nudge it square. Misses. 100ks
Hit to deep square leg. Might've been a thickish inside edge
Tucked towards midwicket, Buttler wanted two - even went halfway down. Stubbs came in and threw it on the bounce to the non-striker's end, the batter was hurried and put a full-length dive
Fullish around off, tentative push. Goes off the outer-half of the bat to mid-off. 98ks, looked like Parag initially wanted to work it to mid-on
Ah, the flat-trajectory familiarity. Shortish and on leg, 96ks, worked towards midwicket
Funky don't work either. Parag shuffles across early and tries to paddle the length ball over short fine, he misses and the ball misses off stump.
Very short. Too much, definite wide this time. Pacy at 142ks but it kept elevating, Parag started shaping to play it but decided to leave
Pitched up outside off, driven to cover
Bouncer beats the pull!. Parag tries to take it on with a powerful hit, too quick
Short-arm whip to mid-on first up. Whiplash in followthrough too, full and at the body

Guided to the keeper! Khaleel's around-the-wicket-angle works. He's cramped Samson for room, who tried to back away and chop the 141ks into-the-pitch ball through point. Ends up nicking it to Pant. Khaleel's jubilant, DC's new-ball bowlers have made it their powerplay.
Good yorker, Buttler squeezes it out well. It was angling to off, Buttler went low and got a thick outside edge as he tried to jam it, ball goes to deep third
Length around fifth, Samson tries to run it down to third with a fully open bat face. Misses. Sniffin-leather stuff
Sharp bumper, pacy but it's too high. No, not a wide. Was outside off and let go
Wide on a length, around sixth stump, Buttler bends his back across and clips it to mid-on. Away from the body but unlike the attempted drives, he made contact here
Chipped uppishly, clears the bowler and lands safely. Mid-on runs to the left and stops it. Length ball around the stumps, Samson stood outside leg and check-punched it
Beaten on the stand-and-deliver square-drive. Hard length around fifth
Length outside off, tapped to point
Good reactions from both players. Buttler charged down to cut the angle but Mukesh probbaly saw him and went length on leg, Buttler was inside the line and managed to glance it to fine leg
Buttler's trying to go big but can't. DC's plan to him seems to be keeping it wide, away from his arc and reach. This three-quarter length ball did both, he tried flaying it square and missed it
Worked off the back foot, Nortje runs to the diagonal left from mid-on and stops three. 135ks on a back of length, angling in at the body, that was really well timed, again
Lovely square punch. Samson stood leg side of the length ball on off, he was just waiting for it to arrive and then opened the face to guide it in the gap in front of point
Proper bumper, proper pull! Not that bad a ball, 144ks, landed very short and rose to around neck-height. Samson was inside the crease and slapped it up and over. The surprise ball doesn't work
Tentative wipe but it gets four to third. Back of length around sixth, may have shaped away a bit. Samson managed to play it with soft hands and got it wide of the diving gully fielder
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket
Khaleel continues being disciplined. Length, angling in towards top of off at 141ks, defended to the left of the bowler.
Length outside off, wide-ish and let go again
Angle takes it too wide, Samson has no need to play that length ball
Three-quarter length on fourth, defended cautiously off the back foot, towards mid-on
Buttler fending away from the body, thickish edge doesn't carry to gully. Lands low to his left and pops back. Was a wide length ball which Buttler played late and tentatively
Ooh, Buttler still happy to have a big crack. Wide and full, angling away, he tries to slay it through cover and misses
Length ball angling back in, Samson tries to play it straight. Might've been another inside edge

Is that one stump out the ground or two? Looks like off stump was flattened and middle rattled. The flying bails was shiver-inducing. Seam-bowling special. 141ks on a length, angling in from around the wicket, decked in to cramp Jaiswal for room on the flick, ball ricocheted off the bat onto the stumps.
Mukesh beats him on the cover drive this time. Wide on a three-quarter length, 136ks, a bit of shape away in the air. Jaiswal going for the full-blooded drive again
Fullish on the pads, might've got a thin edge on the flick onto pad
Trots down and drives wide of mid-off. This is what Kohli did in Bengaluru, get down to length balls and punch it on the up. this one was from top-of-pad height.
Chopped wide of leg stump. Wide and full, Buttler reached out to drive on the up through cover. Too much to do while hitting on the up and aiming square, luckily he gets a single to fine leg
Jaiswal miscues again, Khaleel's had the better of him this over. Went real full and angling into the pad this time, Jaiswal tried whipping it through midwicket and inside edged it.
Fullish outside off, 137ks, Buttler's upper body leans to reach for the drive to the right of mid-off
Pitched up on the pads, inside edge off the gentle flick goes onto pad and deflects towards fine leg
Tad back of length at the body, tucked to midwicket

Doesn't time the flat-bat flap but it clears mid-off, Stubbs ran back but it landed a few metres after sailing past him. Was a shortish 135ks ball outside off that Jaiswal tried to muscle while on the move, ball got big on him.
Wide on a length, Jaiswal middles it first up. Punches it with the swing, away from the body, to point.
Another very full ball on middle, he can only whip it to deep midwicket. Job done Avesh, Royals win their second match in IPL 2024!
Full toss angling away, Axar only makes contact with thin air. All over
Slot ball, Stubbs misses out! Goes hard at that and he only gets it off the inner half to square leg
Very full outside off, Axar can drill it only to long-off
Another yorker, well outside off. Axar cannot dig that out. Huge cheers in Jaipur
Yorker just outside off, Stubbs squeezes it through covers
Very full outside off, Axar glides it fine. Deep backward point has work to do running to his right, keeps it to two
Low full toss just outside off, he goes for the drive but gets a thick inside edge through square leg
Low full toss on off, Axar only manages to hit it to long-on
Very full outside off, only manages to hit it down to long-off
Powered through cover! Stubbs turning it on. Length ball outside off, he smacks it off the meat through the off side
Forehanded over wide long-on! Back of a length slower one outside off, Stubbs walks across and powers it over the fielder running to his right
Full and outside off, powered straight to cover for a quick one
Full toss outside off, drilled to long-off
Yorker well outside off, Stubbs goes for the reverse-scoop but gets it off the toe end towards cover-point

Axar is safe! Punches the length ball towards cover and sets off to the other end. Burger takes a bit of time to transfer the ball to the other hand and throw it to the bowler, who deflects it onto the stumps. But Axar manages to drag his bat in in time
Very full and wide outside off, Axar watches it through. Lands just outside the cut strip but on the pitch
Full and very wide outside off, Axar moves across and looks to repeat the shot but misses. Checks with the ump if that is not a wide
Smartly done. Full and angling away outside off, 136.7kph, Axar gets low and opens the face to get it to deep third
Another carrom ball, despatched in some style. Goes back towards off, clears the front leg and deposits it over wide long-on
Fetch that! Flatter on a length, Stubbs heaves it all the over deep midwicket

Boult horribly misjudges a skier and Stubbs gets a life. Ashwin goes wide of the crease and bowls a carrom ball. He looks to tonk it over the on side but skies it high. Long-on runs in but barely gets a hand to it
Slows it down and tosses it outside off, Axar slogs it and it lands short of deep midwicket
Quicker and flatter, well wide of the batter, wide called
Flatter and quicker on middle, not too short, pulled away to deep square leg
Flatter and spinning in on off, heaved away to deep midwicket's left for two
Fuller outside off, pushed past cover for one
Quicker and outside off, cut to deep point
Flatter and quicker outside off, punched through cover. Jurel has work to do, running to his left from deep point

Porel perishes now. Chahal tosses it up and throws it wide outside off. He knows Porel will charge down again, and he has to fetch the ball from well outside off. Miscues it straight down long-off's throat
Sees Porel charge down and fires it flat and wide outside off, punched towards cover
Tossed up wide outside off, 91.4kph, Porel charges down and hits it wide of long-off
Back of a length, again off pace, Porel hops and guides it to short third for a quick one
Back of a length outside off, 116.1kph, pulled all along the ground to deep midwicket
Length ball outside off, cut away to deep point
Slower one on a length on off, glided towards short third
On a length outside off, punched to deep cover
Thrashes it past cover! Length ball wide outside off, Stubbs this time gets across and connects the punch
Sprays it very wide outside off, Stubbs walks across and looks to sweep but misses. Passes well wide of the cut strip
Floated full outside off, drilled just wide of long-off. Buttler gets around but cannot prevent the second
Quicker and fuller on leg, eased down to long-on. The fielder does well to keep them to one
He comes down the track and eases it past cover for a run
Quicker and wider outside off, he goes back to glide it but misses
Flatter and outside off, goes back and punches it to cover
Chahal strikes! Lands it on a shortish length, angling it wider outside, 91.1kph. Pant has to wait a bit and looks to cut but gets a faint lower edge. Samson does the rest
Fuller and outside off, driven straight to cover. Stubbs came down in search of a run but was sent back. Jaiswal did not collect it in first go but no run results
Angling away on a length, he gets down on a knee and sweeps it to deep midwicket
Full and very wide outside off, left alone. Wide called
Goes wider outside off, Stubbs gets across and drives it to sweeper cover
Slanting away on a length, Pant goes hard at it but gets a thick outside edge to backward point
Full and outside off, he comes forward and ddive it to cover
Angling away on a length, carved to backward point
Beaten all ends up! Length ball angling in on the stumps, 137kph, Stubbs looks to defend but is beaten on the inside edge. Hands on head for Avesh
Full and wide outside off, reaches out and mistimes it towards cover
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover
Length ball on middle, punched back past the non-striker for a quick run

Flying Sandeep ends Warner's stay. No fifty for Warner but the umpires want to take another look. Length ball angling away, he once again flashes hard at it and gets a thick outside edge. Sandeep at short third moves to his right and leaps to catch that. It is a clean one and the Capitals opener has to walk back
Length ball on off, Warner's wrists do it all. He goes back and across and pulls it to beat deep square leg to his left
Warner takes a step down but Sandeep bowls an off-pace length ball wider outside off, 114.7kph, Warner can only push it wide of cover diving to his left
Fuller and wider outside off, glided to deep third
Full and angling away, Warner clears his front leg and hits it to long-off on the bounce
Slower one outside off, pushed past cover
Bangs it short and angling away, takes all the pace off at 111.1kph, Warner is early into the pull but misses
Length ball angling away, slapped through cover-point
Quicker and wider outside off, Pant sweeps it to deep square leg
Fuller outside off, pushed to cover
In the air.... parried over for six! Tossed up and angling across, Pant gets down on a knee and slogs it high towards deep midwicket. Jurel runs back and gets a hand to it but cannot hang on
Full and outside off, driven to long-off
Flatter and quicker outside off, stays a bit low. Warner goes back to hack it across but misses
Quicker and fuller outside off, cut to deep point
Fuller around off, swept to deep square leg
Length on middle, knocks it through mid-on
Fuller on leg, worked away for a run
Uses the width on offer. Goes deep in the crease and cuts the length ball through point
Fuller outside off, defended to the off side

A bad mix-up and Royals fluff a run-out chance. Pant charges down, pushes it towards cover and sets off, before sending Warner back. Jaiswal collects the ball, runs towards Ashwin and then throws it to him on the bounce. Ash is undone by his run perhaps and fails to gather the ball. Warner would have been miles out
Length ball angling away, Warner manages to push it to cover
Yorker outside off, Warner digs it out towards cover
Length ball angling away, knocked out to sweeper cover
Length ball angling away, punched to sweeper cover

Beats deep square leg to his left now!. Back of a length on middle and leg, the slower one, Warner has all the time in the world and pulls it, not in full control, but well away from the fielder in the deep

Full and wide outside off, arner throws his hands to reach out and gets four. He managed to middle that despite seemingly backing away to make room. 135.5kph. Even Chahal's dive was not enough in the deep
Goes back to the length ball and punches it to sweeper cover
Flatter and outside off, Pant waltzes down and wrists it all along the ground through mid-on
A tad slower, 93kph, Warner gets it off the inner half towards midwicket, where Ashwin runs to to stop that
Fuller around off, 93.8kph, pushed to cover
Full and fast just outside off, Warner is hurried and punches it to cover
Tossed up full outside off, Pant reaches out and sweeps it to deep midwicket
146.5kph on the stumps, length ball, pushes it wide of mid-on to keep strike
Back of a length outside off, 140.2kph, Pant has a poke at that but is beaten
Full on the pads again, Pant misses the flick
Full on the pads, he misses the flick
Swiveled and pulled over square leg. Short and angling in, climbing chest high. Warner sinks down a bit and lifts it to deposit it into the crowd

Inside edge! On another day, Warner would be walking back but he gets four today. 147.8kph, length ball outside off, he hangs back and clears his front leg and pushes it through off, but gets it off the inner half past leg
Length ball around off, uppishly pushed to mid-off
Outside off, cut away to point, where Parag misfields and gets them a run
Clean as a whistle! Full length on off, Warner clears his front leg and lofts it straight back over the bowler. Pure timing
Fuller and just around off, guided towards point
Outside off outside off, defended towards point
Scooped high and long. Length ball on middle and leg, 135.8kph, Warner gets down and under it and lifts it over fine leg
Back of a length, beats Pant on defence on the inside and hits him on the back leg. Huge appeal but not given. Height perhaps
Easy way to get going, Pant. On a length outside off, he takes a half-stride forward and steers it past backward point. 147.8kph and the ball does the rest

Bhui bounced out! Burger bangs it short at 138.5kph - it seemed more like 158.3! - Bhui only tries to fend it away. The ball gets big on him and lobs off his front glove. The easiest of catches for Samson who takes a few steps ahead and pouches it. Jaipur roars

Huge appeal for lbw, ump stays unmoved! Samson has a chat with Burger with Ashwin and Chahal around and Royals opt for the review. Did it pitch in line? Length ball at 150kph, Bhui is done it by the pace and is hit on the front pad. But the ball did land outside leg

Gone through the gate! Missile on a length, swinging back in a touch at 145.8kph. Marsh tries to run it down to third but is done in by the inward movement and is knocked over. The after-holi pink hair of Burger sway as he celebrates with full vigour
Length ball outside off, cut away to deep point
Full and angling in on middle, Marsh lofts it over the non-strikers. Two skips and over the ropes. 14 off the over
Length ball on off, defended towards point
Thrashed through covers. Full and outside off, it was the knuckle ball. Marsh gets a good stride forward and finds the gap
Fuller on middle and off, nudged through square leg
Does not middle it. But gets the desired result. Length ball angling in, he transfers his weight back, clears his front leg and heaves it over midwicket
On a length around off, pushed to the on side for a single
Back of a length, angling away, he steers it to deep third to keep strike
Fuller onn middle, defended it back towards the bowler
Edged and flies past the diving short third. No half-measures from Marsh, who just plants his front foot forward and looks to power this away through off
Warner beware! The Bison powers it straight back and the non-striker has to take evasive action. Marsh gets his front foot forward and drills it back, mid-off is straight and yet cannot get to it
Fuller on off and middle, he gets forward and blocks it to mid-off
Creaammmeeedd! Full and just around off, 148kph, Marsh just leans forward and times his push through covers. No stopping that
Full on middle and leg, swinging in, flicked all along the ground to deep midwicket. A wicketless first over from Boult then
Fuller on middle, a hint of swing towards off, Warner pats it to the on side for a quick run
Full on off, dug out towards cover
Outside off, he goes back and slashes it to backward point, where Powell dives to is right and stops
Fuller on off, he hangs back and defends it towards mid-on
Full and a hint of swing around middle and off, he defends back towards the bowler with a half-lunge
